# EssenceWaxStudio.com

> EssenceWaxStudio.com is a premium, exact-match domain for a boutique wax studio — Brazilian wax, hard wax, and appointment-led private studio brands. Available for acquisition at $50,000 USD via Escrow.com.

The site is an informational brand concept for the name plus a domain acquisition listing.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://essencewaxstudio.com/): brand concept, waxing method, studio positioning, buyer FAQ, and domain inquiry form.
- [Insights](https://essencewaxstudio.com/insights/): practical guides on Brazilian waxing, hard wax vs soft wax, prep, aftercare, and studio naming.
- [Domain offer](https://essencewaxstudio.com/#acquisition): asking price, escrow terms, and inquiry form.
